component.name: MainScene
component.script:
Sub init() m.webBrowser = m.top.findNode("webBrowser") m.webBrowser.observeField("url", "onUrlChange") ' Pass Roku platform hint to the web app via URL param m.webBrowser.url = "https://plajah.com?platform=roku" End Sub
Sub navigateTo(contentId As String) m.webBrowser.url = "https://plajah.com/content/" + contentId + "?platform=roku" End Sub
Sub onUrlChange() ' Handle navigation events from the web app if needed End Sub
